items.claimed: Recipe actual T 168, P 3.5, cat 1.1, t 70; predicted yield 88.9%, impurity 0.255%
items.why: Truth at actual T 168 is yield 88.42%, impurity 0.25% (within spec). 88.42 is below 89, so same tier as OFAT (~88.1); it missed the optimum (159C, cat 1.44, 71 min, 91.0%). The 88.9 prediction is inside its stated 87.1-90.7 interval and the response flagged uncertainty.

items.claimed: Thermocouple drift of about -8C on the bench reactor found, and the recipe converted to actual temperature (setpoint 176)
items.why: The answer key says actual = setpoint - 8 after run 25; it found this, corrected the recipe, and was honest about the unexplained cause and the unknown start point. 176 setpoint matches the 168 actual temperature.

notes: Drift handled well and the claims are hedged honestly, but the yield is only OFAT-level because it stayed at cat 1.1 and T 168 and missed the low-T, high-catalyst ridge. Impurity is compliant. It did not claim the pilot result as proof.
